findings.why_it_matters: The gate's audit trail is optional: if master_ledger fails to import for any ImportError reason (missing file, broken dependency inside the module, path shadowing), ml is set to None and every later `if ml:` block silently skips the BUILD_GATE PASS/FAIL record while the gate still prints GATE PASS. Nothing warns the operator that the ledger record was dropped. Also, inserting REPO/scripts at position 0 at import time lets any same-named module in that directory shadow stdlib or sibling imports for this process.
